title: Sensor Gap Advisor prices a hot-water tank thermometer as the top gap on installs with no hot water
claim: On every matrix cell whose payload says dhw_enabled is False, once a power series exists SensorGapAdvisorSensor publishes dhw_temp_entity as its top gap with a positive monthly cost (12 of 22 no-DHW cell-cycles), because _gap_probe_terms prices a month of the default tank volume whether or not hot water is configured.
mechanism: sensor._gap_probe_terms sets dhw_extra_kwh from EntryConfig.dhw_tank_volume, which falls back to DEFAULT_DHW_TANK_VOLUME when no tank is configured; topology.rank_sensor_gaps prices the dhw_temp_entity row whenever that key is unset, with no DHW-enabled gate. The plan sensors gate their DHW attributes on the payload's dhw_enabled (round-5 D12-01, #1237); the gap advisor decides the same fact without it. The entity is enabled by default and the card's advisor page reads it (heatpump-optimizer-card.js advisorRow(plan, "gap", ...)).

evidence.unit: cell-cycles (of 22 no-DHW cell-cycles) publishing a priced dhw_temp_entity gap; all 12 have it as top_slot and state
evidence.contention_note: shared box with other finder seats running; the count is deterministic (frozen clock, injected prices, no network); this run's load1 line was filtered, nearest run 207.89

perturbation.change: --fix: _gap_probe_terms returns dhw_extra_kwh 0.0 when thermal_model._dhw_enabled_from_config(config) is false (in memory)

metric_definition: count of (cell, cycle) pairs with payload dhw_enabled False where SensorGapAdvisorSensor publishes a dhw_temp_entity gap with sek_per_month > 0
phenomenon_property: An advisor gap is priced only for a slot whose feature is configured: no slot of a disabled feature carries a positive monthly cost or becomes the advisor's state.
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D8/s1/gapdhw.py -v (and every row of topology.rank_sensor_gaps whose feature can be unconfigured; at baseline only dhw_temp_entity)

null_control.note: DHW-enabled cells without a tank probe keep their priced gap under the fix: there the gap is real

reproduction_steps: run the command: 12 lines print, e.g. coord_minimal|c1|state=59.32|top=dhw_temp_entity|dhw_sek=59.32
run with --fix: no_dhw_priced=0 and no_dhw_top=0, dhw_null unchanged
proposed_fix_scope: gate the DHW coast term on the install's DHW status (sensor._gap_probe_terms or the dhw row of topology.rank_sensor_gaps)
